Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: original illustrated browser life-strategy game concept, landscape 1536x1024 or similar. Create ONE polished readable proposed game-screen illustration, no desktop/browser chrome. Working title "FASTER LANE" with small "CONCEPT 01 · TOWN & TRANSPORT". Reimagine the charm of a compact 1990s small-town life boardgame with original modern illustrated retro art, humorous storefronts, hand-painted digital gouache, warm cream panels, brick red, muted turquoise, amber, dark ink, restrained grain. Characterful and appealing to kids8-11 AND adults, not preschool, not photoreal, not a mobile monetisation game. Original art only, no copied game assets. Compact town with thirteen distinct destinations around a clear oval/ring road surrounding a central green and very small transport-choice panel. Exact clockwise sequence starting upper middle and travelling right/down/left/up: Starter Court (budget flats), Second Chance (pawn), Bargain Barn (variety), Daily Grind (cafe), Good Threads (clothes), Reboot (devices & repairs), Next Chapter (college), Town Hall Annex (jobs), TownWorks (manufacturing), Nest Egg (bank), Corner Basket (groceries), Parkside (secure flats), Keys & Fees (housing office), then back to Starter Court. Buildings functional with clear iconic clues, playful hand-lettered simple signs; do not add destinations. Bus-stop signs throughout, a tiny town bus, a small worn compact car, rider with bright bicycle; no fuel/stress/social meters. NOT free-roam; board markers show players.
Top slim cream HUD exact large readable text: "MAYA · WEEK 3" "TIME 42 / 60" "CASH $186". Bottom controls "Goals" "Statistics" "Menu". Central panel exact text: "GO TO NEXT CHAPTER" then "Walk 11 time · $0", "Bike 7 time · OWN A BIKE", "Bus 7 time · $3", "Car 5 time · OWN A CAR", small "Includes 2 entry · Concept prices", and single main "TAKE THE BUS". Distances correspond to a three-edge illustrative trip; do not invent different costs or show42-time result. Panel should occupy at most one third of board, legible larger text, not dashboard metrics. Show a friendly small-town world and readable strategic journey. Add small label "PROPOSAL · NOT PLAYABLE".
